A '''criminal''' lead a group of [[Korriban tomb raiders|tomb raiders]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="Tomb Raiders" /> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> The individual, who was known as an eccentric underworld figure, [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] in [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and other looters in batches of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] brought to the planet by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Tomb Raiders" />
